description: This file defines classes and methods for module quality checks in an OpenERP/Odoo environment, including abstract test classes and specific quality check implementations.

classes.name: abstract_quality_check
classes.description: Abstract class for all quality tests, providing common properties and test management.

classes.name: module_quality_check
classes.description: Model representing a quality check for a module, capable of running tests and aggregating results.

classes.name: module_quality_detail
classes.description: Model representing detailed results of individual quality tests.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a specific quality test; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: get_objects
methods.description: Retrieve all object models associated with a given module.

methods.name: get_model_ids
methods.description: Get IDs of models matching specified names.

methods.name: get_ids
methods.description: Get record IDs for a list of object models.

methods.name: format_table
methods.description: Format data as a wiki-style table.

methods.name: format_html_table
methods.description: Format data as an HTML table.

methods.name: add_quatation
methods.description: Calculate the quotient of two numbers.

methods.name: get_style
methods.description: Return CSS styles for HTML display.

methods.name: check_quality
methods.description: Calculate and return the overall quality score of a module, including detailed test results.
